gloss: thinking ability; intellectual capacity; power of thought

definitions.gloss: thinking ability; intellectual capacity; power of thought
definitions.explanation: The ability to think logically, critically, and creatively. Often discussed in education and professional development as a skill to be cultivated.

notes:
A buzzword in Japanese education, where 思考力 is one of the key competencies emphasized in curriculum reforms. Part of the productive ～力 (りょく) pattern meaning 'the power/ability to do X.' Frequently discussed alongside 判断力 (judgment) and 表現力 (expressive ability).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思考力|しこうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to enhance thinking ability
- {思考力|しこうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train one's thinking
- {思考力|しこうりょく}・⟦{判断力|はんだんりょく}→判断力：17617_handanryoku⟧・⟦{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧: thinking, judgment, and expression (education triad)
- ⟦{論理的|ろんりてき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧{思考力|しこうりょく}: logical thinking ability
- ⟦{批判的|ひはんてき}→批判的：05665_hihanteki⟧{思考力|しこうりょく}: critical thinking ability
